title: Prepare for Germany's e-invoicing requirements
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
### Reduce Invoice Rejections and Payment Delays


Validate invoices before delivery and align to trading partner requirements to minimize failed transactions and accelerate cash collection.


### Improve Operational Efficiency


Automate formatting, validation, and routing processes to reduce manual intervention and rework.


### Increase Visibility and Control


Gain insight into invoice status, delivery outcomes, and exceptions to proactively manage issues.


### Support Audit Readiness


Maintain compliant electronic records and a complete transaction trail.
